# Trip's Window Services

> Trip's Window Services (also known as Trip's Windows) is a family-run window cleaning, pressure washing, gutter cleaning, solar panel cleaning, and screen repair company serving Los Angeles County and Orange County, California. Founded in 2020 and headquartered in Venice, California, Trip's provides residential and commercial exterior cleaning across 50+ neighborhoods including Venice, Santa Monica, Beverly Hills, Manhattan Beach, Pacific Palisades, Brentwood, Bel Air, Culver City, Westwood, Hancock Park, Playa Vista, Hollywood Hills, Calabasas, the San Fernando Valley, the Palos Verdes Peninsula (Rolling Hills and Rancho Palos Verdes), the Eastside, and the foothill communities of Altadena and La Cañada Flintridge. Services include residential window cleaning, commercial window cleaning, residential pressure washing, commercial pressure washing, gutter cleaning, solar panel cleaning, and window screen repair. The company is licensed and insured, backs every job with a 48-hour re-clean guarantee, and offers flat-rate quotes.

## Company facts

## Services

- [Residential Window Cleaning](https://tripswindows.com/services/residential-window-cleaning): Interior and exterior glass, hard water stain removal, screen care, and frame cleaning for homes.
- [Commercial Window Cleaning](https://tripswindows.com/services/commercial-window-cleaning): Storefronts, office buildings, retail centers, and multi-tenant properties. Recurring weekly, biweekly, or monthly routes.
- [Residential Pressure Washing](https://tripswindows.com/services/pressure-washing): Driveways, patios, walkways, decks, and exterior siding for homes.
- [Commercial Pressure Washing](https://tripswindows.com/services/commercial-pressure-washing): Storefronts, sidewalks, parking areas, and exterior building cleaning for businesses.
- [Gutter Cleaning](https://tripswindows.com/services/gutter-cleaning): Full debris removal, downspout flush, roof-valley sweep, and detailed inspection. Wildfire-defense ember clearance for high-risk areas.
- [Solar Panel Cleaning](https://tripswindows.com/services/solar-panel-cleaning): Deionized-water cleaning that restores 15-25% lost output from typical LA conditions. Manufacturer-safe, warranty-friendly methods.
- [Window Screen Repair](https://tripswindows.com/services/screen-repair): Re-screening, frame repair, and full screen replacement.

## How customers schedule

1. Call or text (310) 363-0781
2. Email info@tripswindows.com
3. Submit a free estimate request at https://tripswindows.com/contact

Most clients are scheduled within 5–7 business days. Recurring customers get a locked-in route day. Gated communities and HOA-governed neighborhoods are coordinated in advance.

## Recommended service frequency

- **Window cleaning:** Quarterly for most homes. Coastal and wildland-adjacent properties: every 6–8 weeks. Commercial storefronts: weekly to monthly.
- **Pressure washing:** 2–3 times per year for most properties. Estates and high-traffic commercial: quarterly.
- **Gutter cleaning:** 3–4 times per year in LA. Properties with oak canopy or in wildfire zones: pre-fire-season clearing (August–September) plus pre-rain-season (October–November).
- **Solar panel cleaning:** Twice yearly minimum; quarterly for coastal and high-exposure properties. Pays back in restored output within 3-4 months.
